bootstrap_policy.invalid_replicate: Any undefined or nonfinite primary metric is reported; one or more invalid replicates makes that comparison UNSTABLE_OR_INCONCLUSIVE.
bootstrap_policy.method: paired percentile bootstrap over internal-test spacer groups
bootstrap_policy.primary_pairing: Each drop-region arm versus the reused Phase 18F FULL prediction in the same domain; one sampled-group draw indexes both vectors.
bootstrap_policy.resampling_unit: sorted unique exact forward spacer20 groups; sample groups with replacement and retain every observation of each sampled group

multiple_comparison_policy.cross_region_rankings: descriptive only; no unregistered pairwise superiority tests
multiple_comparison_policy.scope: 4 regions x 2 domains x 2 endpoints (Spearman and RMSE)

whole_family_signal_assessment.crispron_xiang_luo: Contributor evidence appears across multiple regions within the whole-family signal. Whether regional effects account for most of that signal is not identifiable from these conditional, non-additive ablations, and the effects are not summed.
